args.title: Fix incorrect script usage in README.md
args.body:
File: README.md

Replace or correct the instruction to use 'npm run serve' since this script is missing in package.json. The change should clarify or fix the start command to avoid the reported "Missing script: serve" error.

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The README.md incorrectly instructs users to run 'npm run serve' to start the API. However, there is no 'serve' script defined in package.json, which causes the reported error message about the missing script. This finding suggests updating the README.md to correct or remove this instruction to avoid confusion.
